about.hero_subtitle: Specialist in Dow Architectural & Structural Silicone Sales and Export
about.mission_title: Trust Through Quality, Value Through Expertise
about.mission_desc: Korea Construction Trading (KCT) supplies world-class Dow silicone products to domestic and international construction sites swiftly and reliably. Beyond simple distribution, we support our clients from product selection to application consulting, partnering in the success of every project.
about.b1_desc: We supply Dow Chemical architectural and structural silicones, offering the full premium product line — curtain wall, facade, weathersealing — to domestic contractors and construction companies.
about.b2_desc: From site managers to large construction firms, we provide B2B special pricing, quotation issuance, and split delivery services tailored to your project scale.
about.b3_desc: We export architectural silicone products to overseas buyers in Japan, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and more. End-to-end export documentation, customs support, and local compliance handling.
about.b4_desc: We go beyond sales by recommending the optimal product for your site conditions and application. We provide the best solution by sealant type — weathersealing, structural, specialty.
about.w1_desc: We supply silicone products from Dow, the world's leading chemical company. Backed by quality assurance and after-sales support.
about.w2_desc: Established supply relationships with major domestic contractors, interior specialists, and international export partners.
about.w3_desc: With domestic inventory always on hand, we respond swiftly to urgent orders. Nationwide split delivery and on-site direct delivery available.
about.w4_desc: Our sales specialists analyze your site conditions and guide you to the optimal product and application method.
about.cta_desc: Our specialists will guide you on product selection, quotations, and delivery schedules for your project.
